messages:
sahil: heads-up: roadmap sync at 3pm. Need a quick decision: do we prioritize Smart Routing (route-by-latency/cost) or Queue Batching Overhaul (lower token costs for high-throughput customers)? Both asks came from Nimbus Health + EchoCommerce. Pinging cross-team leads for fast RICE.
maria: short summary pls — what are the concrete user outcomes?
sahil: Smart Routing: dynamic fallback to cheaper model variant, regional routing to avoid cold starts -> reduces per-request cost by ~18% for mixed workloads and improves p95 latency for interactive flows. Queue Overhaul: move to per-model sharded batching + adaptive batching windows -> reduces token cost ~25% for streaming/bulk, but increases p95 latency risk on small requests.
craig: Eng-runtime: routing needs kernel-level hooks + KV cache invalidation changes. Roughly 4w for prototype, 8w for production hardening (2 engs). Queue overhaul touches scheduler and autoscaler, 6w proto, 6-10w hardening (3 engs).
jess: Eng-platform: routing also needs rollout tooling + canary policy flags. We can own the rollout infra but need 1 platform engineer for 3w during rollout.
leo: SRE: Queue change higher blast radius for latency SLOs. We'll need e2e chaos tests and an emergency revert path.
priya: SE: Nimbus Health cares > compliance and latency under 200ms. They prefer routing because it gives regional affinity + deterministic SLAs. EchoCommerce wants lower unit cost for embeddings-heavy batch pipelines — queue overhaul helps them.
amir: RICE attempt (quick):
```
Feature, Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort, RICE
Routing, 0.4, 6, 0.7, 8, 210
Queue, 0.3, 8, 0.6, 12, 120
```
Numbers rough but suggests routing higher score.
maria: Where are units for Reach/Impact? Are these relative to revenue or requests?
amir: Reach = % of active customers affected (est). Impact = revenue/ops/latency combo scored 1-10. Effort = eng-weeks.
craig: :thumbsup: I trust those priors. Also note routing unlocks future cost controls (tiered models) so long-term multiplier.
jess: If we split staff we can run both in parallel: 2 runtime on routing, 1 runtime + 1 scheduler on queue. But that'll extend timelines a bit.
sahil: Proposal: prioritize Routing as Q2 sprint focus with a 4-week prototype (2 runtime engs + 1 platform), fall back to Queue Overhaul in Q3 with a dedicated squad. Launch criteria for routing: end-to-end canary, <200ms p95 for Nimbus regional tests, cost reduction >=15% on pilot. Agree?
leo: Agree but add: must include chaos tests and automatic fallback to non-routing path before canary.
priya: SE + sales: We'll offer Nimbus a pilot window if criteria met. They can tolerate beta for 6 weeks.
amir: Add an eval: run prompt/sequence-length A/B to catch quality regressions when switching variants.
maria: Okay. I'll update the roadmap doc and RICE sheet. Action items: sahil assign eng leads; craig provide precise WBS by EOD; jess schedule rollout infra; leo draft SLO tests.
sahil: Thanks. I'll DM to assign and post summary after 3pm sync. /deploy-bot note: roadmap update queued.
deploy-bot: Roadmap doc updated: https://redwood.internal/roadmap#Q2. Thread closed unless blockers.
